_about: Qiriness's routine settings the knowledge spreadsheet does not carry. `npm run advisor:load` assembles them with the spreadsheet's Routines and Rules tabs (data/advisor/qiriness-knowledge.json) into the routines the engine runs (scripts/lib/advisory/assemble-routines.mjs). Brand data, edited here; the spreadsheet stays the master for the day and night steps, the main concerns, the ages, the concerns and the products. PROPOSED values are ours until Qiriness confirms them.

concern_map._about: The customer's words (the lexicon's concern keys) → Qiriness's standard concerns (the Rules tab's keys). Same map as the test bench, whose concerns are the template's.

concern_also._about: The customer's words (concern_map's keys) that also count as another standard concern (owner, 2026-10-19: « rougeur, irritation should trigger imperfections as well as peaux sensibles »). Their own concern keeps the sensitive skin; the added one is the main concern the routine and the products answer. « Peau sensible » alone adds nothing.

preselected._about: The routine cards' steps ticked at first, by the Routines tab's step number per moment (owner, 2026-10-19: « only the cream and the serum will be selected at first (but all four will show) »; the evening, the eye serum and the cream). The others show unticked and greyed, theirs to tick. Per main concern (its letter), else `default`; no entry, every step ticked.

_foundation_priority_note: PROPOSED (plan § 3.1): several concerns, none chosen with a button, the tie goes to the first. Sensitive skin (C), oily skin (G) and the basic routine (H) are gone (owner, 2026-10-16): sensitive and oily are skin types now. Qiriness to confirm.

foundations._about: Per main concern (the Rules tab's letters). `skin_types`: a skin type that picks this main concern when no concern is given (owner, 2026-10-14). The steps and how each product is chosen are the Routines tab (owner, 2026-10-16): no required or optional step, no `targets` any more.

Y._about: The eye routine (owner, 2026-10-17): its own steps on the Routines tab; the eyes are a sensitive area; no skin type, its other eye concern instead.

modules._about: Per module type (the Routines tab's modules, kept for later: asked on their own, never added to the day or night routine). `when` adds to the tab's own concerns: the SPF module's are only in its note (« Taches ou teint irrégulier »).

questions._rule: main concern, skin type, age, then day / night / both (owner, 2026-10-16); the eye routine asks its other eye concern instead of the skin type (its own `questions`, under foundations). Every question is asked, even when its answer does not change the routine (owner, 2026-10-17: the answers are kept for statistics). The age and moment chips are labelled by their Rules tab rows, the skin types by the config's labels. A question's sentence is `text`: a button answer gets the next question without a model call.

concern_buttons._about: Question 1, one button per main concern in the Rules tab's order. `value`: the concern(s) the button records (« a+b »: the first is the main concern, the next ones secondary); without one, the main concern's first concern.

eye_concern_buttons._about: Question 1 when the eyes are asked about (owner's notes v4, 2026-10-19: « contour des yeux », then the face's « Rides » gave a face serum). Outside the routine builder; eye concerns, so the eye products answer.

eye_concern._about: The eye routine's question 2: another concern around the eyes (owner, 2026-10-17: one of the three, no « none » button).

variant_choice._about: A routine product sold in several sizes or textures gets one chosen for the customer (owner, 2026-10-18: « between normale and riche, normale should have been chosen »). The texture follows their skin type (Rules tab, skin type → texture); these words find it in the variant's name. Without their skin type, or without a match, the default texture. Variants named with an avoid word (a refill) are never chosen while another exists.

routine_discount._about: Applied to the cart with a routine the builder finished, when the customer adds it (owner, 2026-10-17). Never named: the advisor says the routine discount is applied to the basket. The code must exist in Shopify.
routine_discount._min_products: The routine cards let the customer untick products (owner, 2026-10-18): below this many included products the discount is not applied.

area_fallback._about: Nothing for the need on that area: the face's product for it, said as such (owner's notes v4, 2026-10-19: « if there is no product the falling back to that cream is fine », for dry hands and lips). Rules tab concern keys. An area or a need not listed: nothing, said.

treats._rule: commercial offers, separate from the advice: one at most per conversation (§ 3.4). The products are the spreadsheet's « Petit plaisir » ones.
treats._types: Owner, 2026-10-18: « petit plaisir is only mask, masque tissu and kits ». Only these types are offered as the treat (after a routine, after a « Non », and for a small budget), whatever the sheet's « Petit plaisir » column says; still under max_price. Without `types`, the column decides.

repurchase_opening._about: A signed-in customer opening the chat (owner, 2026-10-29): their favourite product in its repurchase window, under the greeting. The window opens at the product's interval (measured, else « Durée d'utilisation ») less the larger of window_share of it and window_days (« something like 20 %, or 2 weeks ») and closes window_after_share of the interval after it (« not forever … like 50 % »).
repurchase_opening._type_order: The favourite: this type order first (« prioritise creams, serums, lotions etc. (tissue masks last) »), then bought most often, then most recent, then most expensive.
